mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the real GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below its 10-year moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between GDPC1 and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 6-month rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above its 10-year moving average signals a strengthening housing market, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased construction activity and related sectors.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between HOUST and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 5-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 10-year moving average signals a strengthening manufacturing sector, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO and SPX returns becomes statistically insignificant (p > 0.05) in a rolling 5-year window.
